description: Defines the EmiChangeOperation class, representing different types of monetary and operational changes in a loan product, such as disbursements, interest rate changes, capitalized income, and repayment period additions. Includes factory methods for creating instances corresponding to each action, with internal logic for handling specific properties.

classes.name: EmiChangeOperation
classes.description: A data class encapsulating various types of modifications or operations that can be performed on a loan, such as disbursements, interest rate changes, and adding repayment periods. Contains enums, factory methods, and property accessors.

methods.name: disburse
methods.description: Factory method to create an EmiChangeOperation representing a disbursement with specified date and amount.

methods.name: changeInterestRate
methods.description: Factory method to create an EmiChangeOperation for changing the interest rate with specified date and rate.

methods.name: capitalizedIncome
methods.description: Factory method to create an EmiChangeOperation representing capitalized income transaction.

methods.name: addRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Factory method to create an EmiChangeOperation to add additional repayment periods.

methods.name: withZeroAmount
methods.description: Returns a new EmiChangeOperation with zero amount, applicable for disbursement and capitalized income actions.

methods.name: isAddRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Boolean check if the action involves adding repayment periods.

methods.name: isInterestRateChange
methods.description: Boolean check if the action involves an interest rate change.
